dogecoin.text:
$DOGE jumps after Tesla’s Musk promises ‘literal’ moonshot
Elon Musk's tweets keep sending dogecoin into the stratosphere, now with a market capitalization over $8 billion. https://t.co/VkcMY8ZFlg

#Bitcoin  and #Ether got swept up in a crypto market sell-off Tuesday, along with U.S. stocks, before recovering later in the day. Earlier, ether and #dogecoin  touched new all-time high prices. https://t.co/n3od9rh2AV

Per data from BitInfoCharts and Blockchair, the average cost of an #Ethereum transaction is currently $64, partly driven by demand for the Ethereum token (and #dogecoin doppelganger) Shiba Inu (SHIB) – and its own copycats. https://t.co/Ceo23Ea71H
